item.title: MarketBeat Updates News Sentiment Scoring System for BioMarin
item.description:
MarketBeat Updates News Sentiment Scoring System for BioMarin

The latest update from MarketBeat adds new analytics to its news‑sentiment tracking, showing how BioMarin Pharmaceutical (BMRN) is covered in the press this week.

🔍 Overview

  • Extended trading is defined as trading on electronic markets outside regular hours.
  • A fair market value extended hours price is supplied by Massive.
  • MarketBeat tracks headlines from hundreds of trusted media outlets and tags each by company.

🧩 How It Works

  • Each headline receives a score from 2 (good news) to -2 (bad news).
  • The company news sentiment score reflects the average sentiment of articles about the company over the most recent 7 days.
  • A separate average healthcare news sentiment is also calculated.

⚙️ Key Details

Metric Value
BMRN News Sentiment ▼ 0.16
Average Healthcare News Sentiment ▲ 0.39
BMRN Articles This Week ▼ 6

Page Views (this week) 3,329 (‑8%)

🚀 Availability

  • MarketBeat’s SMS alerts are available in Australia, Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, New Zealand, the Netherlands, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
  • By entering a phone number, users consent to receive periodic text messages, which may include stock alerts, news stories, and partner offers. Message and data rates may apply.
  • Users can help via texting HELP and unsubscribe at any time by replying STOP or visiting the mailing preferences page.

💡 Why It Matters

  • The sentiment scores give investors a quick gauge of positive or negative press surrounding a company.
  • Comparing the weekly article count to the average week highlights changes in media attention.
  • Real‑time tracking from over 100 outlets ensures the data reflects the latest market narrative.
